## AutoAllowOrigin {#Sisk_Core_Entity_CrossOriginResourceSharingHeaders_AutoAllowOrigin}

When applied to the [AllowOrigin](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Entity.CrossOriginResourceSharingHeaders.AllowOrigin.md) property, the HTTP server automatically applies
the incoming request Origin header value to the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header.

```csharp
public const string AutoAllowOrigin = "<SISK_AUTO_ALLOW_ORIGIN_NAME>"
```
